q: National Youth Day in India is celebrated on:
12 January marks the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda.
International Yoga Day is observed on:
The United Nations declared 21 June as the International Day of Yoga in 2014.
World Environment Day is observed on:
World Environment Day on 5 June raises awareness about environmental protection.
Human Rights Day is celebrated on:
10 December marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948.
The highest civilian award of India is:
Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian honour, instituted in 1954.

The order is Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.

Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime gallantry award; Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime award.

The Jnanpith is India's highest literary honour for outstanding contribution to literature.
The Dronacharya Award is given to:
Dronacharya honours outstanding coaches; the Dronacharya Lifetime award is for lifetime achievement.
The Arjuna Award is given for:
Arjuna Award recognises consistent outstanding performance in sports.

Nobel Prizes are awarded in Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature, Peace and Economics.

2 October marks Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary and is also the International Day of Non-Violence.
